headerDisplay: Recommended: create a personal access token in the Anova Oven app (More → Developer → Personal Access Tokens) and paste it below. Email and password sign-in still works but isn't needed when a token is set.
footerDisplay: Recipe switches: if you don't add a `recipes` list, the plugin creates Make Toast, Bake, Sous-Vide and Air Fry switches. To customize them, edit the `recipes` list in the JSON config (see config.json.example in the plugin's repository).

email.title: Anova Email Address (only if not using a token)

password.title: Anova Password (only if not using a token)
